id: title:EDsCODE:pass the org to the hogtower database name check

observations.code_quote: params = {"org_id": call.org_id} if call.org_id else None
observations.behavior: Adds an optional org_id parameter to the HogTower database-name check API request.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes warehouse name availability checks to include organization context; without this, names could be incorrectly reported as available or taken across organizations.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized unit test checking that requests are made with and without org_id depending on input.,
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new behavior of including org_id in warehouse identity lookups.

observations.behavior: Updates existing warehouse name lookup tests to expect the org_id parameter when supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures compatibility between managed warehouse client calls and backend expectations after the change.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader system integration or production configuration changes visible.

review.limitations: Only three hunks provided; no broader system integration or production configuration changes visible.
review.reason: The implementation demonstrates a bounded correctness improvement: warehouse name availability checks now correctly account for organizational boundaries by passing org_id. This prevents cross-organization false positives but does not establish systemic risk reduction or broader capability expansion.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's managed warehouse offering where database-name uniqueness must respect per-org isolation.
